svg.text: Print front opening down. Profile: PLA Shell 0.25.
Supports from the build plate below the four front posts only.
Front posts: pilot Ø1.6, drill Ø4.0 x 7 after the print, insert M3 x 3.
Rear posts: printed Ø4.0, 0.5 x 45° relief, 45° gussets.
Lead-in chamfer 0.6 x 45° inside the front opening.
